attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Behavioral Health Licensure

rules.accepted_credit_types: Therapy-related CE meeting OAC 86:15-13-4(c) (qualified presenter; college course, in-service, workshop, conference, home-study or distance course; AAMFT, APA, ACA, NASW, NAADAC national conferences; state/federal mental health agency programs). Board pre-approves ACA/OCA, APA/OPA, AAMFT/OKAMFT, NASW, NAADAC/ODAPCA, ODMHSAS, OK MHP licensing boards and Board-approved providers. 1 college credit hour = 15 clock hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license runs 2 years from the end of the issue month; then a prorated interim period to December 31 (5–20 hours by quarter), then annual calendar-year renewals.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: only CE accrued in the preceding renewal period is accepted.
rules.audit_note: Each November the Board randomly audits 2–25% of active LMFTs; keep attendance documents for 2 years.

topics.who: All LMFTs: mental health ethics (incl. OK LMFT rules, Subchapter 3)
Board-approved LMFT supervisors: therapy supervision specific to Oklahoma law

rules.notes: Annual renewal on or before January 1 (fee and CE due by December 31). Home-study/distance CE allowed if Board-approved; no hour cap stated. Teaching earns 2 h per hour taught.
